items.html: No lifecycle-state authorization — L1 authorizes on role × current_step, not on kernel_status (the ACTIVE guard is L0d's not_active); state-specific rights like "WAITING_HUMAN → operator" → L3
No actor identity authentication — no token/credential; only role-claim vs active role → L7 / L10
No gate / policy — capability is structural authorization, not a decision → L2
No authored capability restrictions in the baseline — the profile abstraction exists, but derives from the step graph until explicit restrictions are introduced → later
No capability-filtered packet ops — available_ops still shows all transitions (coincides with the authorized set under default-derived) → later
